input.overview: 301/Bulls Eye plays a sequence of dart games, with the installed setting either counting from 0 up to 301 or from 301 down to 0. Hit numbered targets and lower saucers, or shoot the top saucer for a 50-point Bullseye, until the dart score reaches its goal. A flashing 2x or 3x top-left rollover multiplies the next number hit. Spell D-A-R-T to flash Grand Dart, then shoot the top saucer for an instant 301 win. Repeated 301 wins eventually light the inside lanes for Extra Ball and the outside lanes for Special at operator-set thresholds.
input.simpleOverview: Hit numbered targets and lower saucers until the dart score reaches 301 or zero, according to the installed setting. Use a flashing 2x or 3x top-left rollover before a valuable number. Spell D-A-R-T, then shoot the flashing top saucer for an instant 301 win.
input.summary: Treat each dart score as the current objective: use the numbered targets for controlled progress, take a flashing 2x or 3x rollover before a useful number, and prioritize D-A-R-T because Grand Dart turns the top saucer into an instant game win.

quickInfo.summary: Reach 301 or zero with numbered shots and saucers.

quickInfo.name: Multiply Next Number
quickInfo.summary: Roll through the flashing 2x or 3x top-left lane.

quickInfo.name: Instant 301 Win
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the top saucer while Grand Dart flashes.

steps.text: Check whether this game counts up from 0 to 301 or down from 301 to zero.
Hit numbered targets and lower saucers to move the dart score toward the current goal; the top saucer scores a 50-point Bullseye.
When 2x or 3x flashes at the top-left rollover, pass through it before hitting a useful numbered target.
Spell D-A-R-T, then shoot the top saucer while Grand Dart flashes to win the current 301 Game immediately.

alternatives.title: Steady-number route
alternatives.when: Use this when the top saucer is rejecting the ball or D-A-R-T is not close to complete.

steps.text: Choose the safest numbered target or lower saucer that moves the dart score toward its goal.
Return to Grand Dart only when D-A-R-T is close enough that its instant win outweighs another controlled number.
Keep winning 301 Games until the inside lanes light for Extra Ball at the installed threshold.
Continue to the higher installed threshold that lights the outside lanes for Special.

machineSetup: Confirm whether switch 6 is set for increasing 0-to-301 or decreasing 301-to-zero play, and post that direction clearly.
Check the operator-set number of 301 wins required for inside-lane Extra Ball and outside-lane Special, plus whether each award gives a ball, replay, or points.
Test the numbered targets, both lower saucers, top Bullseye saucer, D-A-R-T progress, top-left 2x/3x rollover, inside lanes, and outside lanes.

cautions.issue: Score direction and award thresholds are operator-adjustable.
cautions.response: Read the displayed dart score and lit lanes rather than assuming the game counts up or that Extra Ball arrives after exactly two wins.
